title_zh: 曝苹果削减 iPhone 18 Pro 订单，供应链称总量变化不大
content_zh:
据《日经亚洲》10 月 9 日报道，苹果已要求部分供应商下调 iPhone 18 Pro 和 iPhone 18 Pro Max 的零部件订单。

报道援引知情人士称，苹果 10 月对这两款机型的零部件订单较最初要求减少至少 15%，其中一名供应链人士称降幅约为 15% 至 20%。报道认为，存储芯片成本上涨推高了新机售价，可能抑制消费者需求。

不过，供应链方面对订单变化的说法并不一致。界面新闻 10 月 9 日援引苹果供应链公司人士称，苹果近期调整了出货指引，iPhone 18 Pro 订单有所减少，但 iPhone 18 Pro Max 订单增加，目前整体订单量变化不大。

另一名供应链人士则称，苹果是在将部分 iPhone 18 Pro 订单调整至需求较强的 Pro Max 机型，总量没有减少。
title_en: Apple Reportedly Shifts iPhone 18 Pro Orders, Keeping Overall Volume Steady
content_en:
Apple has requested key suppliers to reduce component orders for the upcoming iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max by 15% to 20%, according to a report from Nikkei Asia. Rising memory chip costs driving up retail prices are cited as a primary factor that could temper consumer demand.

However, sources within Apple's supply chain offer a more nuanced perspective. While component orders for the standard Pro model have been reduced, orders for the higher-end Pro Max have actually increased.

Industry insiders indicate that Apple is reallocating production capacity to match stronger demand for the Pro Max, leaving the overall order volume largely unchanged.

title_zh: 苹果调整并购团队架构，7 年来首次重新归入财务部门
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，苹果新任 CEO John Ternus 再次推动公司人事调整：Steve Smith 将接替 Adrian Perica 出任并购主管，并向 CFO Kevan Parekh 汇报；苹果并购团队也将时隔 7 年重新纳入财务部门。

Perica 卸任并购主管后，将继续负责 iCloud、Fitness+ 和 News 业务，并向服务业务主管 Eddy Cue 汇报。Cue 的管理范围将扩大至 App Store、健康和健身团队，Carson Oliver 则升任 App Store 副总裁，负责平台日常管理。报道援引内部知情人士称，苹果尚未对外正式宣布这些调整。
title_en: Apple Restructures M&A Team Back Under Finance Division After Seven Years
content_en:
Apple is executing an organizational shuffle, moving its Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) team back into the finance department for the first time in seven years. Under the new arrangement, Steve Smith will take over as head of M&A from Adrian Perica and report directly to CFO Kevan Parekh.

Following his departure from the M&A role, Perica will focus on overseeing services including iCloud, Fitness+, and News under Services Chief Eddy Cue. Additionally, Carson Oliver has been promoted to Vice President of the App Store to manage its day-to-day operations.

These internal updates, reported by Bloomberg, have not yet been officially announced by Apple.

title_zh: 豆包据称在建设水电燃气缴费等生活服务能力
content_zh:
澎湃新闻 10 月 9 日报道，有用户反馈称，在豆包 App 内通过语音或文字可以发起水、电、燃气等生活缴费指令。接近豆包人士向澎湃新闻表示，豆包正在逐步建设出行服务、生活缴费等生活场景下的办事能力。

豆包此前已上线机票预订、火车票购买、打车出行和路线导航等功能，用户可以直接用自然语言描述需求，由豆包识别意图并调用合作服务。报道称，豆包的生活服务布局还在持续扩展，当前公开信息主要来自用户反馈和接近人士说法。
title_en: Doubao AI Assistant Expands Into Utility Payments and Everyday Services
content_en:
ByteDance's AI assistant, Doubao, is expanding its feature set to include everyday lifestyle services. Recent user feedback reveals that users can now initiate utility payments—such as water, electricity, and gas—using simple voice or text commands within the app.

Sources close to the matter confirmed that Doubao is systematically building out real-world service execution capabilities. The platform already supports travel-related tasks, including flight and train bookings, ride-hailing, and navigation, by interpreting natural language intent to connect with third-party service partners.

This expansion marks another step in Doubao's push to transform from a conversational AI chatbot into a comprehensive, task-oriented personal assistant.

title_zh: 小米 17 Ultra 官网全系涨价 1000 元，华为 nova 16 系列也调价
content_zh:
10 月 9 日，界面新闻查询小米官网发现，小米 17 Ultra 标准版 12GB+512GB 售价已由首发时的 6999 元升至 7999 元，标准版及徕卡版各容量版本均上涨 1000 元。小米客服向界面新闻确认，调价主要受核心元器件采购成本上涨影响，但其后台无法查询具体调价日期。

财联社、科创板日报同日披露，华为 nova 16 和 nova 16 Pro 建议零售价上调 400 元，nova 16 SE 上调 200 元。
title_en: Xiaomi and Huawei Raise Smartphone Prices Amid Escalating Component Costs
content_en:
Xiaomi has quietly increased prices across its entire Xiaomi 17 Ultra lineup by 1,000 yuan ($140) on its official online store. The standard 12GB+512GB model now sells for 7,999 yuan, up from its initial launch price of 6,999 yuan. Xiaomi customer support confirmed that the price hike was primarily driven by rising procurement costs for core components.

Huawei has similarly adjusted pricing for its mid-range lineup. Reports indicate that the recommended retail prices for the Huawei nova 16 and nova 16 Pro have increased by 400 yuan, while the nova 16 SE sees a 200 yuan markup.

title_zh: OpenAI 等公司推演重大 AI 事故后的公众与政策应对
content_zh:
据 Axios 10 月 9 日报道，Anthropic、OpenAI 等 AI 公司的高管正在私下推演：如果 AI 引发重大现实事故，公司如何面对公众反弹，以及随后可能出现的监管行动。

受访人士重点设想的是大规模网络攻击，可能令金融服务、互联网连接，甚至供电和供水中断。情景既包括测试中的智能体失控，也包括恶意使用者利用已开放模型。演练涉及最坏情形的红队测试，以及向美国国会议员解释技术与风险，试图影响危机后可能采用的政策。

OpenAI 发言人确认，公司会开展应急准备演练，让团队讨论并推演多种潜在情景，同时强调，公司不会把这些情景当作必然发生的事，目的是为不同情况做好准备。Anthropic 拒绝置评。

Axios 称，一些业内人士担心未来 6 至 12 个月内出现重大事件。这是受访者对风险的判断，OpenAI 的回应并未将事故视为必然。
title_en: OpenAI and Anthropic Simulate Crisis Scenarios Ahead of Potential AI Disasters
content_en:
Executives at top AI firms, including OpenAI and Anthropic, are privately conducting tabletop exercises to prepare for potential catastrophic AI incidents, according to a report by Axios. These tabletop simulations address extreme scenarios, such as uncontrolled autonomous agents or malicious exploits causing severe cyberattacks that disrupt financial networks, internet backbones, and municipal power or water systems.

The drills focus on crisis management, red-teaming worst-case outcomes, and developing policy messaging for U.S. lawmakers to navigate potential public backlash and regulatory crackdowns. An OpenAI spokesperson confirmed that the company performs preparedness exercises for diverse scenarios, emphasizing that these drills are proactive measures rather than predictions of guaranteed outcomes.

The simulations come amid heightened concern among some industry insiders, who warn that a major real-world AI incident could unfold within the next 6 to 12 months.

title_zh: 保时捷计划提高顶级车型平均售价约 20%，压缩衍生版本
content_zh:
保时捷在 10 月 7 日资本市场日公布新战略，计划在中期将顶级车型平均售价提高约 20%。这一目标来自更高价值的产品组合与定位调整，并非宣布现有全系车型立即涨价。

产品规划将减少约 20% 的衍生版本，同时争取把每个版本的销量提高约 30%。公司还计划推出定位高于 911 的新中置发动机跑车，并在 2030 年前每年至少带来一款能够定义品牌的产品。

保时捷将这套方向称为「Sportwagenschmiede 3.5」，希望降低复杂度，把资源集中到更具品牌辨识度和盈利能力的车型上。
title_en: Porsche Outlines Strategy to Raise Flagship Prices and Cut Model Variants
content_en:
Porsche unveiled its new "Sportwagenschmiede 3.5" strategy during its Capital Markets Day, targeting a 20% increase in the average selling price of its top-tier vehicles over the medium term. Rather than immediate across-the-board price hikes, the price target will be achieved through a higher-value product mix and strategic repositioning.

To optimize efficiency, Porsche plans to trim its derivative model variants by approximately 20% while aiming to boost sales of each remaining variant by 30%. This shift aims to reduce operational complexity and channel resources toward the brand's most recognizable and lucrative models.

Looking ahead, the luxury automaker confirmed plans for a new mid-engine sports car positioned above the flagship 911, committing to release at least one brand-defining model annually through 2030.

title_zh: IDC：第三季度全球 PC 出货量下降 20.1%，旺季未现
content_zh:
IDC 10 月 9 日发布的初步数据显示，2026 年第三季度全球传统 PC 出货量为 6270 万台，同比下降 20.1%，环比下降 9.1%。市场连续两个季度收缩，降幅较第二季度的 3.8% 扩大。

IDC 将下滑归因于持续的供应限制，以及厂商、渠道商年初赶在涨价前提前备货，透支了后续需求。三季度渠道主要消化此前库存，往年「三季度高于二季度」的季节性回升没有出现。联想、HP 和 Dell 的降幅均高于整体市场，合计份额减少 4.2 个百分点。

IDC 消费设备研究总监 Jitesh Ubrani 认为，高库存与高价格正在抑制需求，渠道可能短期促销，但价格难回一年前水平。本次统计覆盖台式机、笔记本和工作站，不含平板与 x86 服务器；出货量也不等同于终端零售销量。
title_en: Global PC Shipments Plunge 20.1% in Q3 as Traditional Peak Season Fails to Materialize
content_en:
Preliminary data released by IDC shows that global shipments of traditional PCs dropped 20.1% year-over-year to 62.7 million units in Q3 2026. On a quarter-over-quarter basis, shipments fell 9.1%, marking the second consecutive quarter of market contraction—a sharp acceleration from the 3.8% decline recorded in Q2.

IDC attributed the downturn to ongoing supply constraints and front-loaded inventory building earlier in the year, which depleted subsequent demand. Channels spent the third quarter digesting existing stocks, causing the market to miss its usual seasonal uptick. Major players Lenovo, HP, and Dell all underperformed the broader market, with their combined market share shrinking by 4.2 percentage points.

According to Jitesh Ubrani, research director at IDC, high inventory levels and elevated prices continue to suppress consumer demand. While short-term channel promotions may occur, prices are unlikely to return to levels seen a year ago.

title_zh: 英国皇家邮政承认广告使用 AI 配音，已故演员家属质疑声音被复刻
content_zh:
Deadline 10 月 9 日调查披露，英国皇家邮政承认其 2025 年圣诞广告使用 AI 配音。已故 BBC 播音员、曾为《帕丁顿熊》配音的 Paul Vaughan 的女儿认为，广告声音与父亲高度相似，并质疑未经家属许可复刻声音。

制作方 Fameplay 称，配音通过 ElevenLabs 生成，但否认有意克隆 Vaughan。声音专家向 Deadline 表示，两者确有相似之处，仅凭听感无法证明直接克隆；ElevenLabs 则未回答训练材料来源问题。

争议发生后，ElevenLabs 已将 Vaughan 纳入禁止直接克隆的名单。广告使用 AI 配音已经得到确认，是否使用了这位演员的声音材料，仍是双方争议所在。
title_en: Royal Mail's AI Christmas Ad Sparks Controversy Over Late Actor's Voice Rights
content_en:
Royal Mail has admitted to using AI voiceovers in its 2025 Christmas advertisement, sparking controversy after the daughter of the late BBC broadcaster Paul Vaughan raised concerns over unpermitted voice cloning. Vaughan, who notably narrated *Paddington Bear*, featured a voice strikingly similar to the one used in the ad, according to his family.

Production company Fameplay stated that the audio was generated via ElevenLabs but denied intentionally cloning Vaughan's voice. While audio experts acknowledged the uncanny similarity, they noted that listening alone cannot definitively prove direct cloning. ElevenLabs declined to clarify the source material used for training its model, though it has since added Vaughan to its list of voices banned from being cloned.

While the use of AI voiceovers in the campaign is confirmed, debate continues over whether the late actor's archival audio was improperly utilized to train the generative model.

title_zh: 曾被字节辞退的田柯宇获近 3000 万美元融资，研发世界模型
content_zh:
据彭博社报道，曾因违规被字节跳动辞退的田柯宇，已为一家研发世界模型的实验室筹集近 3000 万美元，投后估值约 2 亿美元。投资方包括五源资本和 IDG，两家机构均向彭博确认了投资。

这个约 10 人的团队尚无正式名称或产品。田柯宇说，团队已构建包含 20 万个符号的「视觉字典」，希望用 AI 自己的符号处理视频，再输入约 1 亿小时的视频学习现实世界，计划于 2027 年发布完整模型。

田柯宇是 NeurIPS 2024 最佳论文之一、视觉自回归模型 VAR 论文的第一作者。彭博查阅的裁决显示，他因违反与字节的合同被判赔 50 万元。他在采访中承认，曾关闭另一名实习生的程序以释放算力，并表示如果重来，会采取更明智的做法。

这家公司目前优先研发技术，田柯宇称尚未把精力放在消费产品或商业模式上。
title_en: Ex-ByteDance Researcher Raises $30M for World Model AI Startup at $200M Valuation
content_en:
Keyu Tian, a former ByteDance researcher dismissed for contractual violations, has raised nearly $30 million for a new AI lab focused on developing world models, valuing the company at around $200 million. Investors 5Y Capital and IDG Capital have confirmed their participation in the round.

The 10-person startup, which currently lacks an official name or commercial product, is building a visual dictionary of 200,000 symbols to process video data natively. The team plans to train its AI on approximately 100 million hours of video to understand physical reality, targeting a full model release by 2027.

Tian, lead author of a top NeurIPS 2024 paper on Visual AutoRegressive (VAR) models, was previously ordered to pay 500,000 RMB for breaching his contract after shutting down another intern's process to free up compute resources. Tian acknowledged the mistake, stating that he is currently prioritizing core technology development over commercial products.

title_zh: Jev 开发商 TypeSafe AI 融资约 8.7 亿美元，估值达 75 亿美元
content_zh:
据彭博社 10 月 9 日报道，AI 模型 Jev 的开发商 TypeSafe AI 完成约 8.7 亿美元（约合人民币 58 亿元）融资，估值达到 75 亿美元（约 500 亿元人民币），由 Andreessen Horowitz（a16z）领投。

这笔融资在 Jev 发布数周后完成。联合创始人 Diogo Almeida 表示，产品发布视频走红后，企业高管、开发者和投资者对公司的兴趣迅速增加。

TypeSafe 称，Jev 的用户数在数天内突破 100 万，约三分之一的《财富》500 强企业已使用该模型；公司未公开这些企业的名称。
title_en: TypeSafe AI Reaches $7.5 Billion Valuation Following $870 Million Funding Round
content_en:
TypeSafe AI, the developer behind the AI model Jev, has raised approximately $870 million in a new funding round led by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z), pushing the startup's valuation to $7.5 billion.

The investment comes just weeks after the official launch of Jev. According to co-founder Diogo Almeida, interest from corporate executives, developers, and investors surged rapidly after a promotional launch video went viral online.

TypeSafe reported that Jev surpassed one million users within days of its release. The company also claimed that roughly one-third of Fortune 500 companies have adopted the model, though specific client names remain undisclosed.

title_zh: 尼康取消显微视频赛事原冠军资格，称作品违反生成式 AI 规则
content_zh:
尼康取消了今年 Small World in Motion 显微视频大赛原第一名作品的获奖资格。尼康表示，该视频不符合赛事关于生成式 AI 的规则，更新后的冠军已改为 Nguyen Nam Nhat 的作品。

据 The Verge 10 月 9 日报道，原获奖者 Ning Xu 博士的视频声称展示了一名原发性纤毛运动障碍（PCD）患儿呼吸道中，微小纤毛的运动。视频真实性在网上受到质疑后，尼康于上周开始复核。

Xu 在 LinkedIn 评论中承认使用了 AI，但将其描述为后期处理：利用无监督神经网络，对超分辨率光学成像重建的灰度图像进行特征区分和可视化。尼康最终认定作品违反比赛规则，视频现已从赛事网站移除。

尼康表示，将重新审视未来比赛的规则和评审程序，同时强调，取消资格不应被解读为对参赛者专业声誉、科研贡献或意图的判断。
title_en: Nikon Disqualifies Microscopy Contest Winner Over Generative AI Violation
content_en:
Nikon has disqualified the first-place winner of its annual Small World in Motion microscopy video competition, citing a violation of its generative AI policies. The top prize has now been awarded to runner-up Nguyen Nam Nhat.

The original winning submission by Dr. Ning Xu contained footage that claimed to show the movement of microscopic cilia in the respiratory tract of a child with Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia (PCD). After online skepticism mounted regarding the video's authenticity, Nikon launched a formal review of the entry.

In a LinkedIn comment, Xu acknowledged using an unsupervised neural network during post-processing to visualize and differentiate features from super-resolution optical grayscale images. Nikon ultimately determined that the process breached competition rules and removed the video from its platform.

Nikon announced plans to review guidelines and judging procedures for future contests, while emphasizing that the disqualification is not a judgment on Xu's professional reputation, scientific contributions, or intent.

title_zh: 💡 AHM 呼吁数学研究回到以人类理解为中心
content_zh:
人类数学协会（AHM）传播工作组 10 月 7 日发表声明，批评 OpenAI 前一天集中公开数学手稿的做法，并呼吁数学家停止与 OpenAI 合作。陶哲轩随后在个人博客转载了这份客座声明。这份公开信将争议落在数学研究的规范与理解上，并对模型给出的答案如何成为学术成果提出质疑。

AHM 写道，数学家对进步有一套受历史与学科特点塑造的认识。可信、符合研究伦理且服务公共利益，是评价数学研究的条件。协会因此拒绝 OpenAI 关于这次发布推动数学进步的主张，并建议数学家与公众审慎看待这种发表模式。

声明还援引数学与人工智能咨询小组（AGMAI）的建议，称前沿 AI 公司不应擅自用内部模型测试高级数学问题；AHM 认为，OpenAI 忽视这一前提，却借用该咨询小组为自身提供正当性，损害了学术共同体的规范。

对一次公开超过 700 份文件，AHM 的判断是：这更像力量展示，不能仅凭规模视为学术贡献。它提出的方向是回到以人类理解为中心的科学实践。这是 AHM 的组织立场；陶哲轩在转载说明中标明作者身份，并未将其作为自己署名的声明。

🔗 相关阅读：陶哲轩转发抵制声明，数学界和OpenAI彻底撕破脸
title_en: Mathematics Association Urges Focus on Human Understanding, Calls for Halt to OpenAI Collaboration
content_en:
The communications working group of the Association for Human Mathematics (AHM) has issued a statement urging mathematicians to halt research collaborations with OpenAI following the AI firm's bulk release of over 700 mathematical manuscripts. Renowned mathematician Terence Tao later shared the guest statement on his personal blog.

The open letter rejects OpenAI's assertion that its mass disclosure advances mathematical progress, emphasizing that genuine academic contributions must be trustworthy, ethically conducted, and aligned with public interest. AHM characterized OpenAI’s release as a display of corporate power rather than a meaningful scientific effort, questioning how AI-generated outputs are being framed as scholarly achievements.

The statement also highlighted guidelines from the Advisory Group on Mathematics and AI (AGMAI), which advised against AI companies testing advanced math problems on internal models without oversight. AHM accused OpenAI of ignoring these standards while using the advisory group's name to legitimize its actions.

Advocating for a return to science centered on human comprehension, AHM called on both the mathematical community and the public to scrutinize automated publishing models. Tao clarified that while he hosted the statement on his blog, it reflects the organizational position of AHM rather than his personal endorsement.

title_zh: 比亚迪公开人形机器人外观专利，面向服务、教育和工业场景
content_zh:
国家知识产权局 10 月 9 日公示了一项具身智能机器人外观设计专利，专利权人为比亚迪股份有限公司。专利说明显示，这款人形机器人具备行走、平衡和交互功能，可用于服务机器人、教育或工业场景。

比亚迪执行副总裁李柯今年 6 月曾表示，希望未来每家比亚迪门店都部署 2 至 3 台机器人，用于讲解和演示车辆。此次公开的是外观设计专利，尚未披露具体产品发布时间或量产安排。
title_en: BYD Secures Humanoid Robot Design Patent for Service, Education, and Industrial Use
content_en:
China's National Intellectual Property Administration has published a design patent for an embodied humanoid robot assigned to BYD Co., Ltd. The patent describes a robot featuring walking, balancing, and interactive capabilities, designed for service, educational, and industrial applications.

This development aligns with vision shared in June by BYD Executive Vice President Stella Li, who expressed plans to deploy two to three robots in every BYD showroom for vehicle demonstrations. While the design patent has been disclosed, BYD has yet to announce specific product launch dates or mass production plans.

title_zh: TRAE 合并 TraeWork 与 TraeCode，支持 Agent 和 IDE 双模式
content_zh:
TRAE.ai 宣布将 TraeWork 与 TraeCode 合并为全新 TRAE，并开始分批灰度推送。新版提供 Agent 模式和 IDE 模式，覆盖桌面、Web 与移动端；前者围绕任务协作展开，后者保留编辑器内的开发体验。

开发者可以在同一工作区管理多个项目，并行运行多个 Agent，连接本地项目或 SSH 远程环境。自动化、模板和「我的助理」则用于处理重复任务及文档、汇报、整理等编码之外的工作。

代码变更、HTML、PPT、Word、图片、视频和报告统一进入「我的产物」。官方同时给出两款旧客户端的不同迁移路径，聊天记录、账户及本地数据等按对应方案保留。
title_en: TRAE.ai Merges TraeWork and TraeCode into Unified Dual-Mode Platform
content_en:
TRAE.ai has officially consolidated TraeWork and TraeCode into a unified platform named TRAE, which is now rolling out in phased batches across desktop, web, and mobile environments. The revamped platform offers two primary operating modes: an Agent Mode focused on task collaboration and an IDE Mode designed to deliver a seamless, editor-centric development experience.

Developers can now manage multiple projects within a single workspace, run parallel AI agents, and connect to local files or remote SSH environments. The platform also streamlines non-coding workflows—such as documentation, reporting, and routine tasks—through automated workflows, templates, and an intelligent personal assistant. All project deliverables are centralized under a unified "My Assets" hub.

To ensure a smooth transition, TRAE.ai has outlined specific migration paths for existing users, preserving account details, chat histories, and local data.

title_zh: JetBrains 发布 Mellum 2.1，重点增强智能体编程能力
content_zh:
JetBrains 发布编程 AI 模型 Mellum 2.1，继续采用 12B 混合专家架构、2.5B 活跃参数和 Apache 2.0 许可证。此次更新把强化学习从短期收尾环节扩展到训练主体，并加入数学、算法竞赛、工具调用和软件工程等任务数据。

Mellum 2.1 可以探索代码库、编辑文件并检查修改结果，JetBrains 称其能识别失败测试的根因、起草修复方案并验证结果。模型已登陆 Hugging Face，支持本地或自有基础设施部署；单请求场景下，多 Token 预测可让速度提升约 1.6 倍，高负载推理吞吐量接近 Qwen3.5-9B 的两倍。
title_en: JetBrains Releases Mellum 2.1, Boosting AI Agentic Coding Capabilities
content_en:
JetBrains has officially released Mellum 2.1, an open-weights coding AI model built on a 12B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 2.5B active parameters under an Apache 2.0 license. The latest update expands reinforcement learning across the primary training pipeline and incorporates specialized dataset coverage across mathematics, competitive programming, tool invocation, and complex software engineering tasks.

Engineered for agentic coding workflows, Mellum 2.1 can autonomously explore codebases, modify files, and verify changes. According to JetBrains, the model excels at pinpointing the root causes of failing tests, drafting automated patches, and verifying fix outcomes.

Now available on Hugging Face for local and on-premise deployment, Mellum 2.1 delivers notable efficiency gains. Multi-token prediction boosts single-request speeds by approximately 1.6x, while high-load inference throughput reaches nearly double that of Qwen3.5-9B.

title_zh: 一加与京东方发布第四代东方屏，支持全局 165Hz、游戏 185Hz
content_zh:
一加与京东方 10 月 9 日发布第四代东方屏，将由 10 月 12 日发布的一加 16 首发搭载。新屏采用双方定制的 X4 发光材料和全新 LTPO 超高刷电路，日常场景支持全局 165Hz，游戏场景最高支持 185Hz。

一加称，新电路与发光材料配合后，全局 165Hz 功耗与上代 120Hz 屏幕基本持平。自研超级显示芯片 P4 则针对快速滑动和游戏中的运动画面优化动态清晰度。

显示部分还包括三次硬件校准、1nit 暗光显示、3840Hz PWM 调光，以及 1.15mm 四等边。官方同步确认，一加 16 将配备 9000mAh 冰川电池；本次亮相的是屏幕技术，整机发布会将在 10 月 12 日举行。
title_en: OnePlus and BOE Unveil 4th-Gen Oriental Screen with Up to 185Hz Refresh Rate
content_en:
OnePlus and BOE have officially unveiled their fourth-generation Oriental Screen display technology, which will make its debut on the upcoming OnePlus 16 on October 12.

Co-developed with custom X4 luminescent materials and a new LTPO ultra-high refresh rate circuit, the panel supports a global 165Hz refresh rate for daily use and up to 185Hz in gaming scenarios. OnePlus claims that power consumption at 165Hz matches the previous generation's 120Hz display, supported by a proprietary P4 display chip that enhances motion clarity during fast scrolling and gameplay.

Additional panel specifications include 3,840Hz PWM dimming, a 1-nit low-light mode, triple hardware color calibration, and ultra-thin 1.15mm symmetric bezels. OnePlus also confirmed that the OnePlus 16 will feature a 9,000mAh Glacier Battery during its official launch event on October 12.

title_zh: 新款理想 i6 披露六项升级，10 月 28 日正式发布
content_zh:
理想汽车 10 月 9 日披露新款 i6 的六项升级。新车将于 10 月 12 日在巴黎完成欧洲首秀，并于 10 月 28 日正式发布。

🔗 相关阅读：相关阅读：新款理想 i6 六项升级
title_en: Updated Li Auto i6 Teased with Six Major Upgrades Ahead of October 28 Launch
content_en:
Li Auto disclosed six key upgrades for the updated i6 model on October 9.

The revised electric vehicle is scheduled to make its European debut in Paris on October 12, ahead of its official market launch on October 28.

title_zh: 山姆拟限制亲友卡换绑，一年最多关联两名主卡会员
content_zh:
山姆会员商店 10 月 9 日宣布，拟修改会员章程并公开征求意见，新增亲友卡实名身份的绑定限制。

按拟议规则，从首次激活亲友卡之日起每 365 天，同一实名身份信息最多只能用于激活两名个人主卡会员的亲友卡；同一时刻，只能激活一名个人主卡会员的亲友卡。

这两项限制分别针对一年内可关联的主卡人数和同时生效的关系。征求意见期满如无更改，新规则将于 10 月 16 日生效，目前仍处于征求意见阶段。
title_en: Sam’s Club Proposes Stricter Rules on Family Card Transfers to Curb Sharing
content_en:
Sam’s Club announced proposed amendments to its membership terms on October 9, introducing real-name binding restrictions for supplementary family cards.

Under the proposed rules, a verified real-name identity can only be linked to a maximum of two primary membership accounts within any 365-day period. Additionally, an identity can only be actively tied to one primary account at any given time.

These measures aim to prevent account-sharing abuse. If passed following the public consultation period, the updated policy will officially take effect on October 16.

title_zh: Saint Laurent 创意总监 Anthony Vaccarello 将离任，结束十年任期
content_zh:
开云集团 10 月 9 日宣布，Anthony Vaccarello 将离开 Saint Laurent 创意总监一职，结束长达十年的任期，继任者将稍后公布。

Vaccarello 于 2016 年接替 Hedi Slimane。他任内以埃菲尔铁塔为背景举办大秀，延续品牌的巴黎身份，也推动 Saint Laurent 进入电影制作，参与了《艾米莉亚·佩雷斯》等作品。

在上周的最后一场秀中，他以金色礼服、风衣和高跟鞋呼应 Yves Saint Laurent 当年办秀的场景。此次人事变化发生在开云 CEO Luca de Meo 推动集团调整之际；Saint Laurent 也成为集团旗下此轮最后更换创意总监的主要品牌。
title_en: Anthony Vaccarello to Step Down as Saint Laurent Creative Director After a Decade
content_en:
Kering announced on October 9 that Anthony Vaccarello will step down as Creative Director of Saint Laurent, bringing his ten-year tenure at the legendary house to a close. A successor will be named at a later date.

Vaccarello, who succeeded Hedi Slimane in 2016, firmly anchored Saint Laurent's Parisian legacy through cinematic runway shows against the backdrop of the Eiffel Tower. Under his creative direction, the house also expanded into film production, backing acclaimed projects such as *Emilia Pérez*.

His final presentation last week paid homage to Yves Saint Laurent’s classic runway era, showcasing gold gowns, trench coats, and stilettos. The departure comes amid broader organizational restructuring led by Kering CEO Luca de Meo, making Saint Laurent the latest major brand in the luxury group’s portfolio to undergo a creative transition.

title_zh: 《旺达幻视》主创将为亚马逊开发《星际之门》新剧
content_zh:
据 Variety 10 月 9 日独家报道，《旺达幻视》主创 Jac Schaeffer 正在为 Amazon MGM Studios 开发一部新的《星际之门》剧集。消息人士称，项目预计不久后组建编剧室；亚马逊和 Schaeffer 的代表均拒绝置评。

新剧属于 Schaeffer 今年与 Amazon MGM 签订的整体合作协议。Safehouse Pictures 的 Joby Harold 与 Tory Tunnell 也将担任执行制片人。这是亚马逊再次尝试开发《星际之门》电视剧，此前由 Martin Gero 推进的版本最终未能继续。

Schaeffer 曾为 Marvel 与 Disney+ 创作《旺达幻视》，随后负责衍生剧《阿加莎》的编剧、统筹与执行制片，并执导其中部分集数。《星际之门》则从 1994 年由 James Spader、Kurt Russell 主演的电影起步，后来衍生出播出十季的《星际之门 SG-1》，以及《星际之门：亚特兰蒂斯》等剧集。
title_en: 'WandaVision' Creator Jac Schaeffer to Develop New 'Stargate' Series for Amazon MGM
content_en:
*WandaVision* creator Jac Schaeffer is developing a new *Stargate* television series for Amazon MGM Studios, according to a report by Variety on October 9. The project is expected to launch a writers' room shortly under Schaeffer's overall deal with Amazon MGM, with Joby Harold and Tory Tunnell of Safehouse Pictures on board as executive producers.

This marks Amazon's latest attempt to reboot the celebrated sci-fi franchise, following an earlier iteration led by Martin Gero that did not move forward.

Schaeffer gained widespread acclaim for creating Marvel and Disney+'s *WandaVision* before serving as showrunner, writer, and executive producer on its spinoff *Agatha All Along*. The *Stargate* franchise originated with the 1994 feature film starring James Spader and Kurt Russell, which later expanded into long-running TV series including *Stargate SG-1* and *Stargate Atlantis*.

title_zh: AI 剧集《Space Nation》《Kira》将在 Mipcom 放映完整试播集
content_zh:
两部使用生成式 AI 制作的科幻剧集《Space Nation》和《Kira》宣布，将于 10 月 12 日、13 日在戛纳 Mipcom 电视市场面向买家放映完整试播集。两部作品均由 Ex Machina Studios 制作，K5 International 负责全球销售。

《Space Nation》由 Utopai Studios 与巴西流媒体 Globoplay 联合制作，计划共 8 集、每集 45 分钟，讲述地球面对外星威胁时，一群年轻精英飞行员投入战斗的故事。Marco Weber 与 Martin Weisz 联合创作，Weisz 执导全部剧集。

法国制作的《Kira》计划共 6 集、每集 35 分钟，由 Damien Steck 与 Julien Petit 创作、执导。少女 Kira 在活着的星球 Djena 上穿越变化的地貌与不同派系，寻找失踪父亲。K5 称，本次带到市场的是已完成的剧集，区别于概念短片或预览片。

Utopai 此前公布 2027 年推出 3 部电影、2 部剧集的计划；本次试播集放映是相关作品制作与发行的新进展。
title_en: AI-Generated Sci-Fi Series 'Space Nation' and 'Kira' to Screen Full Pilots at Mipcom
content_en:
Two science fiction series produced using generative AI, *Space Nation* and *Kira*, will screen their full pilot episodes for buyers at the Mipcom television market in Cannes on October 12–13. Both titles are produced by Ex Machina Studios, with K5 International handling global sales.

Co-produced by Utopai Studios and Brazilian streamer Globoplay, *Space Nation* is an eight-part series following elite young pilots defending Earth against an alien threat. The project was co-created by Marco Weber and Martin Weisz, with Weisz directing all episodes.

Meanwhile, the French production *Kira* is a six-part series that follows a teenage girl searching for her missing father across the evolving landscapes and factions of a living planet. K5 highlighted that full, finished episodes—rather than proof-of-concept trailers—will be presented to potential distributors, signaling a major step forward for Utopai's content pipeline through 2027.

title_zh: 冰岛犯罪剧《Elma》定档 10 月 15 日上线
content_zh:
冰岛犯罪剧《Elma》宣布将于 10 月 15 日在当地平台 Síminn 上线。剧集改编自 Eva Björg Ægisdóttir 的畅销小说系列，由 Unnur Birna Backman 饰演警探 Elma。

Elma 在一段感情受挫后返回家乡阿克拉内斯，加入当地警队。灯塔脚下出现一具女性尸体，调查逐步揭开小镇过去的秘密；同事 Saevar 则成为她面对案件与个人生活时的重要伙伴。

剧集由《绝境》等作品的导演 Katrín Björgvinsdóttir 与 Þóra Hilmarsdóttir 执导，Glassriver 与比利时 Lunamine 联合制作，Mediawan 负责全球销售，芬兰 MTV 已预购。
title_en: Icelandic Crime Drama 'Elma' Set for October 15 Premiere
content_en:
The Icelandic crime drama series *Elma* is set to premiere on October 15 on the local platform Síminn. Adapted from Eva Björg Ægisdóttir's bestselling novel series, the show stars Unnur Birna Backman as Detective Elma.

The narrative follows Elma as she returns to her hometown of Akranes after a heartbreak to join the local police force. When a woman's body is discovered near the town lighthouse, her investigation uncovers long-hidden secrets within the community. Along the way, her colleague Saevar becomes an essential ally in both her personal and professional life.

The series is co-directed by Katrín Björgvinsdóttir (*Trapped*) and Þóra Hilmarsdóttir, and co-produced by Iceland's Glassriver alongside Belgium's Lunamine. Mediawan is handling international distribution, with Finland's MTV already securing pre-broadcast rights.
